name: Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore
summary: A bounty in Lakeshire calls for Lieutenant Fangore's death. Magistrate Solomon seeks hunters to stop the Shadowhide gnolls pressing into the Redridge Mountains. Fangore serves the renegade sorcerer Morganth, and his death would strike at Morganth's forces.

sections.title: A Town Under Siege
sections.body: Lakeshire faces growing danger. Stormwind's army is stretched thin, and King Varian Wrynn is mysteriously absent. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon has left frontier settlements like Redridge to defend themselves. The Shadowhide clan raids trade routes, burns farmsteads, and presses against the town's perimeter. Magistrate Solomon posts bounties to draw mercenary blades where royal soldiers will not march.

sections.title: Morganth's Lieutenant
sections.body: Lieutenant Fangore leads the Shadowhide gnolls as Morganth's enforcer. Morganth is a rogue dark wizard hiding in the Redridge hills. Under Fangore, the gnolls coordinate their attacks instead of fighting as scattered scavengers. Their strikes threaten to sever Lakeshire from Elwynn Forest. Fangore's severed paw would give Magistrate Solomon proof that Morganth's brute vanguard has been broken.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Fangore leads the Shadowhide gnolls in Redridge, coordinating their raids and enforcing the will of Morganth, a dark sorcerer who threatens Lakeshire.

faq.q: Who posted the bounty for Lieutenant Fangore?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon, Lakeshire's town leader, posted the bounty to defend Redridge's perimeter from hostile gnolls and dark spellcasters.

faq.q: Why doesn't Stormwind send soldiers to handle the gnolls?
faq.answer: Stormwind is paralyzed by King Varian Wrynn's sudden disappearance and domestic unrest. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and the House of Nobles have refused to send regular army detachments to outlying towns like Lakeshire, leaving Magistrate Solomon to hire mercenary adventurers.

faq.q: What proof is required to claim the bounty?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon requires Lieutenant Fangore's severed paw as proof that the Shadowhide warlord has been slain.

faq.q: Who is Morganth and why does Fangore follow him?
faq.answer: Morganth is a rogue human spellcaster who practices dark magic from a tower in the Redridge Mountains. He has bent the Shadowhide gnolls to his will and uses Lieutenant Fangore as an enforcer to terrorize the countryside.
The Shadowhide are a ferocious gnoll clan in the crags and forests of the Redridge Mountains. Their aggression and brutal ambushes have plagued Lakeshire's settlers for years.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Lakeshire is a key stronghold in Redridge. Removing Fangore would keep the settlement from being cut off.
As a human, you feel Stormwind's neglect in Redridge firsthand. Facing the gnoll chieftains is a matter of survival for your home.
